information: ## Trick or Treat! Get ready for Davis Halloween Party! ![](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/rails/active_storage/blobs/redirect/eyJfcmFpbHMiOnsiZGF0YSI6MjA4MDA4LCJwdXIiOiJibG9iX2lkIn19--62f69192e4eec984125c5da0a2d565d8ba0dee43/HalloweenParty2026Logo.png) - All attendees under the age of 18 are required to be accompanied by a parent or guardian. - Competition attendees may **appear on livestream and media**. - If we run ahead of schedule, we will start first round events no earlier than 20 minutes. - Competitors may not compete in an event if they miss last call for that event. In general, last call is a few minutes after the last group is called. **This competition is organized in partnership with [West Coast Cubing](https://www.westcoastcubing.com/), [Speedcubeshop](https://speedcubeshop.com/), and [GANCUBE](http://gancube.com/)** ![](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/rails/active_storage/blobs/redirect/eyJfcmFpbHMiOnsibWVzc2FnZSI6IkJBaHBBZ0dKIiwiZXhwIjpudWxsLCJwdXIiOiJibG9iX2lkIn19--60fae70c3e469b91d58257f4370c58af47b487da/scswcc5.png)![] (https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/rails/active_storage/blobs/redirect/eyJfcmFpbHMiOnsiZGF0YSI6MjEzNjI2LCJwdXIiOiJibG9iX2lkIn19--9b4d4fd246b01a7378ff206a750c5f85d79240d4/GAN%20logo%20%E6%A8%AA%E7%89%88%20(%E7%94%B5%E5%AD%90%E7%89%88)_1%20(1).jpg)
